200.description: The plan was revised (version + 1), or equals the stored one (nothing changed).

path_id.description: The process path code in its canonical form (trimmed, upper case), whatever case the request used.

shift_start.description: Absent when the plan was committed without one.

heads_source.description: request when planned_heads was sent; forecast when it was derived from the workload forecast.

version.description: 1 for a first commit, + 1 per commit that changed the plan.

warnings.description: Advisory, computed against the facility tally on every read (never stored, never null): a warning when the tally knows at least one but fewer stations of the activity named like the path than installed_stations (zero tallied stations is no tally data: no warning). The number is reported as sent, never replaced.

201.description: A first commit; the plan is stored at version 1.

path_id.description: The process path code in its canonical form (trimmed, upper case), whatever case the request used.

shift_start.description: Absent when the plan was committed without one.

heads_source.description: request when planned_heads was sent; forecast when it was derived from the workload forecast.

version.description: 1 for a first commit, + 1 per commit that changed the plan.

warnings.description: Advisory, computed against the facility tally on every read (never stored, never null): a warning when the tally knows at least one but fewer stations of the activity named like the path than installed_stations (zero tallied stations is no tally data: no warning). The number is reported as sent, never replaced.

400.description: Malformed JSON (a fractional head or station count included) or a shift_start that is not RFC 3339 (malformed-json, malformed-shift-start).

409.description: The stored version moved twice while the plan was committed (version-conflict); retry it.

422.description: planned_heads above installed_stations (heads-exceed-stations), omitted heads that cannot be derived (missing-planned-heads), a head or station count below 0 or above 2147483647 (invalid-count), installed_stations omitted (missing-installed-stations), a rate or hours not above zero (non-positive-rate, non-positive-hours), or rate x heads x hours not finite (throughput-not-finite).

500.description: An unexpected failure (a store or outbox error). Answered as problem+json (internal-error). A 5xx answer is never stored under an Idempotency-Key and rolls back the aggregate change and its outbox rows, so the retry re-executes.
